6100cec4-b6a9-4110-8c58-60470d104911.author: anon-2101b8a8
6100cec4-b6a9-4110-8c58-60470d104911.content: Rewrote GAP-REPORT.md as a source-first review with 20 finding groups and paired ferrolearn/sklearn 1.5.2 implementation references. Includes independently traced defects beyond header status claims: Bayesian GMM convergence is log of normalized responsibility sum, SparsePCA penalizes sample codes rather than feature components, MLP alpha scaling differs by batch size, IterativeImputer uses element max rather than matrix infinity norm and skips complete-data regression fitting, neighbor R2 contradicts default sklearn, TruncatedSVD pads unavailable components, DictionaryLearning fitted OMP default bypasses its helper default, and weighted LogisticRegression loses weights on unpickle. Existing tests were not used as acceptance evidence; no further test runs or library edits. Checked report source paths/line bounds and git diff --check. Retained prior name/signature TSVs as secondary inventory. Coverage limits explicitly listed.

d488a507-2e4a-422c-be54-ef7058399b17.author: anon-2101b8a8
d488a507-2e4a-422c-be54-ef7058399b17.content: Generated source-derived API inventory from sklearn 1.5.2 doc/api_reference.py (559 documented entries) and reachable ferrolearn rustdoc. Of 471 ML-facing names, 424 exact Rust names, 12 named Rust analogs, 35 no named item; Python exports 68 documented classes. Live signature comparison of those 68 wrappers finds 45 constructors with missing sklearn parameters, 31 fit methods with missing parameters, and 44 wrappers missing at least one selected sklearn method. Building the Python extension via maturin develop automatically upgraded sklearn to 1.9.1 because pyproject.toml requires >=1.6; restored isolated oracle to 1.5.2 for comparison.

d6b1f604-fe38-43af-b2c4-cc6fbd61843b.author: anon-2101b8a8
d6b1f604-fe38-43af-b2c4-cc6fbd61843b.content: Source-level review found concrete algorithm/contract differences in BayesianGaussianMixture (non-variational updates, diagonal-only full covariance, normalized-responsibility convergence), SparsePCA (penalty on wrong factor), MLP (regularization normalization and stopping), IterativeImputer (wrong norm and complete-data shortcut), HDBSCAN, GP optimization, halving search, KMeans/MiniBatchKMeans, neighbor R2, and weighted LogisticRegression pickle reconstruction. Findings are derived from executable implementation branches paired with sklearn 1.5.2 source; passing tests and REQ-status comments are not parity evidence.
